newsitem.title: USA: Baldwin Technology says Misomex talks end.
newsitem.headline: Baldwin Technology says Misomex talks end.

text.p: Baldwin Technology Co Inc on Friday said negotiations with the investor group that signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets of its Misomex pre-press operation have been mutually terminated.
Earlier this month an unnamed investor group offered the company $4 million for the business.
The company said it was committed to selling Misomex and was pursuing discussions with several other interested parties.
Baldwin said it thought the current carrying value of the Misomex pre-press business represented the best estimate of its fair market value. The company declined to specify the carrying value.
"We anticipate no further charges related to the divestiture, however that is contingent upon future events," said Bill Lauricella, Baldwin's chief financial officer, in a telephone interview.
